headword: {文学|ぶんがく}{作品|さくひん}

definitions.explanation: Covers novels, poetry, drama, and other literary forms.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{文学|ぶんがく}{作品|さくひん}を{読|よ}んでみたい。
examples.english: I want to try reading Japanese literary works.

examples.japanese: この{文学|ぶんがく}{作品|さくひん}は{多|おお}くの{言語|げんご}に{翻訳|ほんやく}されている。
examples.english: This literary work has been translated into many languages.

examples.japanese: {授業|じゅぎょう}で{近代|きんだい}{文学|ぶんがく}{作品|さくひん}を{分析|ぶんせき}するレポートを{書|か}くことになった。
examples.english: I have to write a report analyzing modern literary works for class.

notes:
Composed of {文学|ぶんがく} (literature) + {作品|さくひん} (work, piece). A general term encompassing all forms of written artistic expression including novels, short stories, poetry, essays, and drama.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {近代|きんだい}{文学|ぶんがく}{作品|さくひん}: modern literary work
- {古典|こてん}{文学|ぶんがく}{作品|さくひん}: classical literary work
- {文学|ぶんがく}{作品|さくひん}を{読|よ}む: to read a literary work
- {文学|ぶんがく}{作品|さくひん}を{分析|ぶんせき}する: to analyze a literary work
- {代表的|だいひょうてき}な{文学|ぶんがく}{作品|さくひん}: representative literary work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {著作|ちょさく}: written work (broader, includes non-literary writing)
- {小説|しょうせつ}: novel (specific literary form)
- {作品|さくひん}: work (generic, applies to any creative field)
- {名作|めいさく}: masterpiece (evaluative, not genre-specific)
